items.title: PACCAR builds a fleet app platform into Kenworth, Peterbilt
items.content_text: PACCAR Connect arrives in early 2027 and links Kenworth and Peterbilt drivers to Platform Science's Virtual Vehicle app marketplace, days before PACCAR reports…
